source_autosprite.base_provenance: v003 magenta source despilled to a flat transparent base, tight-reframed to ~74% width / ~65% height fill (matches lunabi base_padded footprint), then uploaded as a NEW character to avoid the dirty-magenta fringe of the original maribo character.
source_autosprite.prompt: 49-frame click-reaction Live2D one-shot for Maribo, a chibi pink dolphin Ringpet. Start from the click pose, then surprised cheerful bounce: eyes widen, smile opens, fins flick, single cyan trident lifts and tips, small water splash under feet, then settle back. High readability at 200px UI size: large clear face, bold clean outline, crisp eyes, simple teal shell armor, sharp trident silhouette, no noisy tiny details, no blur/haze/glow wash. Keep pink skin, purple eyes, teal armor, clam chest shell, full body and full trident inside frame. Transparent, no text/UI/crop.

runtime_sheet.frame_interval: intended 16 fps one-shot pingpong; 49 AutoSprite frames + deterministic reverse 48..0
runtime_sheet.source_scale_repack: 1024 raw cell premultiplied-alpha resized to 968px content centered in 1152px cell (offset 92), matching Koyora/Lunabi near-native footprint

postprocess.tool: Near-native AutoSprite premultiplied-alpha safe-margin repack + mild unsharp + deterministic pingpong reassembly (NO Real-ESRGAN upscale)
postprocess.operation: 2026-06-20 re-repack: the clean HQ-readable AutoSprite 49f source cells (1024px) were premultiplied-alpha resized DOWN to 968px (near-native, like Koyora), given a single mild RGB unsharp pass, alpha<=15 clipped, centered in 1152px cells at offset 92, then assembled as deterministic forward frames 0..48 plus reverse frames 48..0 (98f). This REPLACES the prior Real-ESRGAN animev3 x2 + strong unsharp pipeline, which had pushed Maribo's edge energy to an artificial ~2377 lapVar (highest of all pets) on top of an inherently soft native render, producing an over-processed 'AI-upscaled' texture that read visibly different from the natural-soft sibling pets.
postprocess.upscale: none; raw AutoSprite 1024px cells were preserved near-native by resizing DOWN to 968px inside 1152px runtime cells (Koyora pipeline parity).

unsharp_mask.mode: single mild per-cell RGB unsharp tuned so the result lands in the natural-soft peer band (lapVar ~1023, vs Lunabi 1051 / Nekuring 1158) instead of the artificial 2377.

alpha_cleanup.operation: Pixels with alpha <= 15 set fully transparent after premultiplied resize.

sharpness_metric.metric: variance of Laplacian over alpha-masked luma, content normalized to 500px tall
sharpness_metric.rationale: near-native repack places Maribo at its OWN source-illustration sharpness (1023 vs source 1055) and in the natural-soft peer band. This proved the residual 'graphics not good' complaint was NOT a sharpness/resolution problem (a follow-up realesrgan-x4plus-anime test measured 1504, OVER-sharpening past the source, and was rejected).

value_contrast_punch.reason: Root of the residual complaint was Maribo's pale pastel palette (pink body + pale cyan armor) = weak value contrast, reading flat/washed next to high-contrast peers (lunabi dark-purple, koyora red/gold). NOT sharpness. Fixed by a value-contrast/saturation pass, not by sharpening.
value_contrast_punch.scope: applied to RGB of all 98 cells, alpha preserved exactly; RGB re-zeroed where alpha<=15. whole-sheet edge alpha 0.
value_contrast_punch.rejected_alt: mild/strong punch variants tested; strong (contrast 1.34/sat 1.28) read candy/artificial, mild too subtle; med chosen.

qa.candidate_reject_note: Compact no-platform candidate cmpwryl8l00282lxhm7i0qlp5 was rejected for intermittent crop/edge-touch and weaker mid-motion face read before postprocess.

root_cause_note: Maribo previously read lower-quality than Lunabi because (1) the v003 magenta source was NOT a flat #ff00ff chroma key (corners ranged R218-235, G10-36, B185-209), so chroma removal could never be clean; and (2) maribo's body is pink, which is close in hue to magenta, so AutoSprite removeBg left magenta/pink edge fringe. Per the CLAUDE.md chroma-key rule, a pink character should use a green (#00ff00) key, not magenta. Lunabi's dark-purple body + perfectly flat #ff00ff source avoided both problems. This asset fixes (1)+(2) by despilling to a clean transparent base before upload.
status: Accepted runtime asset (2026-06-20, two passes): (1) re-repacked the SAME clean HQ-readable AutoSprite 49f click reaction near-native (no Real-ESRGAN) into 968px content / 1152px cells, deterministic 98f pingpong -> natural-soft peer band (lapVar 1023, matching Lunabi 1051); then (2) applied a user-approved value-contrast/saturation 'med punch' pass because the residual 'graphics not good' complaint was the pale pastel palette's weak value contrast, NOT sharpness (Option A already matched the 1055 source). Identity and pose unchanged. Backups: pre-Real-ESRGAN-removal at .tmp/maribo_optionA/maribo_click_live2d_pingpong_98f_PRE_OPTIONA_BACKUP.png; pre-punch (Option A) at .tmp/maribo_optionA/maribo_click_live2d_pingpong_98f_OPTIONA_PRE_PUNCH.png.
sharpen_status: Real-ESRGAN animev3 x2 + strong unsharp pipeline REMOVED. The artificial edge energy it added (lapVar ~2377, highest of all pets, on a soft native render) was the cause of Maribo's over-processed look. New pipeline = near-native downsize + single mild unsharp -> lapVar 1023 (natural-soft peer band). Edge-touch QA: 0 cells, whole-sheet edge alpha: 0.
